description: Use this when an S-corp owner asks how much salary they should pay themselves ("reasonable compensation," "am I paying myself right?"). Given net profit and what drives it, returns a starting salary RANGE, the distribution left over, the employment tax that classification avoids, and the facts-and-circumstances test the IRS actually applies. Emphasizes that a defensible figure needs a comp study.

business_net_profit_usd.description: Annual net profit of the S-corp BEFORE any owner salary (revenue minus business expenses).

profit_driver.description: What drives the profit: "primarily_owner_services" (consulting/agency/solo professional), "mixed" (your work plus staff/systems), or "capital_or_product" (product/capital/team, not your labor). Defaults to primarily_owner_services.
